task: A disposable SQLite-backed card service in current accepted Jadpo source
surface: Every endpoint is explicitly public for this local pilot

input.changes: optional title and optional nullable note

obligations: duplicate identity returns card_conflict and preserves original row
short or overlong title rejects with 400 before insertion
patching title preserves an omitted note
empty patch returns empty_patch and preserves state
invalid patch returns 400 and preserves state
patching a missing row returns card_missing
stored state survives a fresh process
